mapper.select: select e.enrollment_id as enrollmentId, e.class_date as classDate, e.cancel_request_status as cancelRequestStatus, e.settlement_method as settlementMethod,e.lesson_credits as lessonCredits,e.lesson_completed_time as lessonCompletedTime, s.class_mode as classMode, s.lesson_location as lessonLocation, s.start_time as startTime, s.end_time as endTime, e.enrollment_code as enrollmentCode, e.schedule_id as scheduleId, e.student_name as studentName, e.contact_phone as contactPhone, e.enrollment_status as enrollmentStatus, e.pay_status as payStatus, e.billing_status as billingStatus, e.payable_amount as payableAmount, e.create_time as createTime, s.course_class_name as courseClassName, s.term_name as termName, s.period_name as periodName, s.time_slot as timeSlot, s.grade_name as gradeName, s.subject_name as subjectName, coalesce(nullif(trim(teacher.user_name), ''), nullif(trim(teacher.nick_name), ''), s.teacher_name) as teacherName, c.campus_name as campusName, c.classroom_name as classroomName from edu_enrollment e inner join edu_course_schedule s on s.schedule_id = e.schedule_id left join sys_user teacher on teacher.user_id = s.teacher_id left join edu_classroom c on c.classroom_id = s.classroom_id where e.parent_id = #{parentId} and e.del_flag = '0' order by e.create_time desc, e.enrollment_id desc

select e.enrollment_id as enrollmentId, e.class_date as classDate,e.cancel_request_status as cancelRequestStatus, s.class_mode as classMode,s.lesson_location as lessonLocation, e.schedule_id as scheduleId, e.student_name as studentName, e.enrollment_status as enrollmentStatus, e.pay_status as payStatus, s.schedule_code as scheduleCode, s.course_year as courseYear, s.course_class_name as courseClassName, s.term_name as termName, s.period_name as periodName, s.time_slot as timeSlot, s.start_time as startTime, s.end_time as endTime, coalesce(e.class_date,s.start_date) as startDate, coalesce(e.class_date,s.end_date) as endDate, s.class_pattern as classPattern, s.grade_name as gradeName, s.subject_name as subjectName, coalesce(nullif(trim(teacher.user_name), ''), nullif(trim(teacher.nick_name), ''), s.teacher_name) as teacherName, s.class_type as classType, c.campus_name as campusName, c.classroom_name as classroomName from edu_enrollment e inner join edu_course_schedule s on s.schedule_id = e.schedule_id left join sys_user teacher on teacher.user_id = s.teacher_id left join edu_classroom c on c.classroom_id = s.classroom_id where e.parent_id = #{parentId} and e.del_flag = '0' and e.enrollment_status in ('1', '报名成功') and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' order by s.course_year, s.term_name, s.period_name, s.start_time, s.schedule_id

select adjustment_id as adjustmentId, schedule_id as scheduleId, original_date as originalDate, adjusted_date as adjustedDate, reason from edu_schedule_adjustment where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} order by original_date

select s.course_class_name as courseClassName, max(s.grade_name) as gradeName, max(s.subject_name) as subjectName, max(s.teacher_name) as teacherName, max(s.term_name) as termName, max(e.student_name) as studentName, count(e.enrollment_id) as totalCount, sum(case when ifnull(a.attendance_status, '0') = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as attendedCount, sum(case when ifnull(a.attendance_status, '0') = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pendingCount, sum(case when ifnull(a.attendance_status, '0') = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as canceledCount from edu_enrollment e inner join edu_course_schedule s on s.schedule_id = e.schedule_id left join edu_attendance a on a.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id and a.del_flag = '0' where e.parent_id = #{parentId} and e.del_flag = '0' and (e.enrollment_status in ('1', '报名成功') or a.attendance_status = '1') and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' group by s.course_class_name order by max(s.course_year), max(s.term_name), max(s.period_name), max(s.start_time), max(s.schedule_id)

select e.enrollment_id as enrollmentId, e.schedule_id as scheduleId, e.student_name as studentName, s.course_class_name as courseClassName, s.term_name as termName, s.period_name as periodName, s.time_slot as timeSlot, s.start_time as startTime, s.end_time as endTime, s.grade_name as gradeName, s.subject_name as subjectName, s.teacher_name as teacherName, c.campus_name as campusName, c.classroom_name as classroomName, ifnull(a.attendance_status, '0') as attendanceStatus, a.attended_time as attendedTime, a.confirm_name as confirmName from edu_enrollment e inner join edu_course_schedule s on s.schedule_id = e.schedule_id inner join edu_classroom c on c.classroom_id = s.classroom_id left join edu_attendance a on a.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id and a.del_flag = '0' where e.parent_id = #{parentId} and e.del_flag = '0' and (e.enrollment_status in ('1', '报名成功') or a.attendance_status = '1') and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.course_class_name = #{courseClassName} order by s.course_year, s.term_name, s.period_name, s.start_time, s.schedule_id

select count(1) from edu_course_schedule s inner join edu_classroom c on c.classroom_id = s.classroom_id where s.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.class_mode != '2' and s.recruit_status = '0' and c.status = '0'

select count(1) from edu_enrollment where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and parent_id = #{parentId} and (lesson_account_id = #{lessonAccountId} or (lesson_account_id is null and student_name = #{studentName})) and del_flag = '0' and enrollment_status in ('0','1','待确认','已确认','报名成功')
mapper.update: update edu_course_schedule s inner join edu_classroom c on c.classroom_id = s.classroom_id set s.enrolled_count = ifnull(s.enrolled_count, 0) + 1, s.update_by = 'miniapp', s.update_time = now() where s.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.recruit_status = '0' and c.status = '0' and (s.class_mode = '2' or s.enroll_limit is null or s.enroll_limit <= 0 or ifnull(s.enrolled_count, 0) < s.enroll_limit)
mapper.insert: insert into edu_enrollment ( student_id,lesson_account_id, enrollment_code, schedule_id, parent_id, student_name, student_phone, contact_phone, enrollment_status, pay_status, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( (SELECT student_id FROM edu_student_lesson_account WHERE account_id=#{lessonAccountId} AND parent_id=#{parentId}),#{lessonAccountId}, #{enrollmentCode}, #{scheduleId}, #{parentId}, #{studentName}, #{studentPhone}, #{contactPhone}, '报名成功', '未支付', '0', '0', #{createBy}, now() )
mapper.select: select enrollment_id from edu_enrollment where enrollment_code = #{enrollmentCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into edu_attendance ( attendance_code, schedule_id, enrollment_id, parent_id, student_name, attendance_status, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{attendanceCode}, #{scheduleId}, #{enrollmentId}, #{parentId}, #{studentName}, '0', '0', '0', #{createBy}, now() )
mapper.select: select enrollment_id as enrollmentId, parent_id as parentId, schedule_id as scheduleId, del_flag as delFlag, enrollment_status as enrollmentStatus from edu_enrollment where enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} limit 1
